sheets.prompt: Cozy chunky pixel art with clearly visible square pixels, top-down 3/4 RPG perspective (camera tilted so building fronts and character faces are visible; NOT isometric, NOT pure overhead). Crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering noise, flat shading with 2-3 tones per material, 1px dark warm outline (#2A1F1A-like deep brown/navy). Soft warm morning light from the upper left, shadows as one flat darker tone falling to the lower right. Calm, warm, cozy mood of a small Indonesian town. Limited palette built around: warm cream #F7EEDA and #E9D8B4; muted green #A5BE93, #6F9262, #44603F; soft brown #C9A27A, #9A6F4C, #5E3F2A; dark navy #1F2A44, #34456B. Sparing accents only: mustard #D9A441, terracotta #C0654A. Furniture sprite sheet for toko_kosmetik_kos. Items left to right: Rak Kosmetik Dinding 1 (64x96 px, role: wall_back), Sofa Tunggu Pengunjung (64x64 px, role: wall_back), Poster Promo Skincare (48x64 px, role: wall_decor), Etalase Display Lip Tint (96x64 px, role: free), Meja Cermin Tester 1 (64x80 px, role: cluster). Every item is front-facing (facing the camera), top-down 3/4 RPG view, drawn as ONE separate object with a flat straight base along its bottom edge, no walls, no floor, no surrounding room. Items are drawn at consistent real-world scale relative to each other with the same visible pixel size. All screens, labels, frames and book spines blank or abstract. Flat solid magenta #FF00FF background, no shadows on the background. Match the art style, pixel size, outline weight and palette of the reference image exactly. Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, real-world brand names, photorealism, 3D render, smooth vector art, glow, neon, soft airbrushed shading, drop shadows with blur, emoji, isometric view, extra characters, cropped subjects, busy backgrounds, anti-aliased edges.
